title: Command Output Schema
description: Declarative description of a command's stdout layout, used by the |: structured pipe to parse output into a typed table. Files live in output-schemas/ (one per command) and are embedded into the dsh binary; ~/.config/dsh/output-schemas/ overrides them.

outputs.description: Candidate specs; the first whose subcommand/when match wins

subcommand.description: Required first non-option argument, e.g. "ps" for `docker ps`

args_include.description: All must be present. "-l" also matches combined clusters (-la); "--opt" also matches --opt=value

inject_args.description: Arguments appended before the command runs, e.g. ["--format", "{{json .}}"]

parse.description: json: one document; json-lines: one object per line; text: use the spec's text definition

json_root.description: For parse: json — unwrap this top-level key first (e.g. "items")

separator.description: whitespace (default): split on whitespace runs; auto: fixed-width columns located by header text positions; {"delimiter": ...}: fixed delimiter

header_lines.description: Header lines to skip; the last one drives auto column detection

skip_prefixes.description: Skip lines starting with any of these (e.g. ls -l's "total ")

name.description: Column name in the resulting table

header.description: Header text when it differs from the name (e.g. "%CPU"); required for auto separators

type.description: percent: 3.5% → 3.5 (float); size: 1.5K/2Gi/bytes → integer bytes; duration/date: kept as string

rest.description: This (final) column greedily takes the rest of the line
